parsed_json.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.max_phase,
  di.mesh_heading,
  md.first_approval
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_indication di ON di.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
ORDER BY md.first_approval DESC
